services.title: General Consultation
services.description: Comprehensive health assessment and medical advice
services.details: Our doctors provide thorough health evaluations, diagnose common illnesses, and offer preventive care guidance. We focus on holistic healthcare that considers both physical and spiritual well-being.

services.title: Blood Pressure Check
services.description: Regular monitoring of blood pressure levels
services.details: Regular blood pressure monitoring is essential for cardiovascular health. Our clinic provides accurate readings and counseling on maintaining healthy blood pressure levels.

services.title: First Aid & Wound Dressing
services.description: Emergency first aid and professional wound care
services.details: Professional wound dressing and first aid services for cuts, burns, and minor injuries. We ensure proper cleaning, dressing, and follow-up care to prevent infection.

services.title: Antenatal Services
services.details: Comprehensive antenatal care including regular check-ups, nutritional guidance, and preparation for safe delivery. We work closely with expectant mothers to ensure healthy pregnancies.

services.title: Child Wellness Clinic
services.description: Pediatric care and child health monitoring
services.details: Specialized care for children including growth monitoring, vaccinations, nutritional assessment, and developmental check-ups. We provide a nurturing environment for young patients.

services.title: Vaccinations
services.details: Complete vaccination services following WHO and Nigerian health guidelines. We maintain proper cold chain storage and provide counseling on vaccine-preventable diseases.

services.title: Pharmacy & Drug Dispensing
services.details: Licensed pharmacy services with quality medications. Our pharmacists provide medication counseling, dosage instructions, and ensure safe dispensing practices.

services.title: Health Counseling
services.details: Personalized health counseling covering nutrition, exercise, stress management, and lifestyle modifications. We integrate faith-based wellness principles into our counseling.
